clips.title: The story
paras: Vile Fin Scales are harvested from the murloc tribes prowling the waterways and northern coasts of Tirisfal Glades. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society utilizes these resilient biological samples in their ongoing research to engineer a devastating new plague.

The Royal Apothecary Society works relentlessly to craft a virulent blight capable of decimating both the living and the Scourge. Simple toxins are easy enough to brew, but creating an infectious disease that spreads effortlessly across populations requires specialized alchemical properties. Apothecary Johaan in Brill studies Vile Fin scales specifically to understand how their natural resilience and mucous coatings can aid in stabilizing and transmitting his experimental contagions.

The Vile Fin tribe infests the northern shores and western shallows of Tirisfal Glades, threatening travelers and encroaching upon Forsaken territory. Gathering their scales serves a dual purpose for the Undercity: keeping the feral murloc populations in check while providing Johaan's laboratory with fresh organic components for biochemical warfare tests.
